cover.coreProposition: When current remote authority is explicitly required, stale cached policy may remain stored evidence but must not retain authorization power; the runtime should represent unresolved freshness as an explicit restrictive authority state with named affected capabilities and recovery conditions.
cover.visualMetaphor: A preserved document remains visible behind glass while a separate permission gate waits for a fresh seal
cover.semanticObject: A calm policy archive on one side and a closed capability portal awaiting current authority on the other
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a clear separation between retained evidence and active permission, using deep blue and restrained amber
